description: This source file implements the DepositAccountOnHoldTransactionReadPlatformService interface and provides methods to retrieve deposit account on-hold transaction data from a database. It uses JDBC to execute SQL queries, maps result sets to data objects, and supports pagination and search parameters.

classes.name: DepositAccountOnHoldTransactionReadPlatformServiceImpl

methods.name: retriveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of on-hold deposit account transactions filtered by savings ID, guarantor funding ID, and search parameters.
